title: submit_montage_sections specification
description: specification payload for action=submit_montage_sections (Animation domain, WS-10). The Animation domain's first write path. sections[] is the COMPLETE desired section set per ADR-0004 — any section on the montage that is not listed is REMOVED. Because that is destructive, options.dry_run defaults to true and the caller must pass dry_run:false to apply. Notifies, slots and segments are not covered.

sections.description: Complete desired section set. A montage with no sections cannot be played, so an empty array is rejected.

name.description: FCompositeSection::SectionName. Must be unique within the submitted set.

start_time.description: Absolute start time in seconds. Must not exceed the montage play length.

next_section.description: Section this one chains to on completion. Must name another section in this submitted set. Omit for no chaining.
